_comment: Country groupings. A member is an entity id, or {"id", "from", "to"} with inclusive membership years. Members can also come from UN M49 codes (m49_region / m49_subregion / m49_intermediate) minus `exclude`; those apply to all years. In any given year a country may belong to at most one group.

groups.name: European Union
groups.note: Membership as of each year (European Communities before 1993). The UK is counted as a member through 2020, the end of the Brexit transition period.

groups.name: ASEAN
groups.note: Membership as of each year. Timor-Leste was admitted in October 2025.

groups.name: Africa
groups.note: All countries in the UN M49 region Africa.

groups.name: South America
groups.note: UN M49 intermediate region South America.

groups.name: Central America & Caribbean
groups.note: UN M49 Central America and Caribbean, excluding Mexico.
